text:
ana.s: Heads up — nightly shows +18% tail latency on seq=1024 workloads after yesterday's kernel-selector change.

josh: ugh. which change? the tile-merge heuristic?

ana.s: yep, changed threshold for preferring fused-gemm kernels. PR #4820

priya: can you drop nsys traces for before/after? nvtx markers are enabled right?

ana.s: yes. linked traces: before: https://perfetto.google.dev/trace/before-1773 (nsys) after: https://perfetto.google.dev/trace/after-1773

liam: ran quick nsys: 
```
nsys profile -o run_after --sample=none --cpuctxsw=false --trace=cuda,cublas --nvtx true -- ./bench --seq 1024 --batch 1
```

liam: timeline shows a ton more small kernel launches in attention forward, and cublas_gemm_ex calls went up ~3x.

sam-runtime: did we regress KV cache hits? more misses would amplify kernel runs.

ana.s: KV metrics stable across runs (hit-rate ~98%). this looks like a kernel selection/tiling issue, not KV.

josh: can you paste the shortened kernel timeline diff? small sample is fine.

liam: here is a cut from the trace (before vs after):
```
BEFORE:  attention_fused_forward  (1 launch,  1.2ms)  cublas_gemm_ex (2 launches, 0.9ms)
AFTER:   attention_fused_forward  (12 launches, 0.12ms each) cublas_gemm_ex (7 launches, 0.3ms)
```

liam: net effect: overhead from kernel launches + extra cublas setup / copy paths.

priya: started git bisect. suspect range: a1b2c3..d4e5f6 (roughly last 48 hrs of change).

liam: bisect found culprit: d4e5f6 — the tile-merge threshold change that prefers smaller fused tiles for marginal throughput wins.

liam: repro commands I used:
```
# before
git checkout a1b2c3
cmake --build build -j12
NSYS_OUTPUT=before nsight profile -o before --trace=cuda,cublas -- ./bench --seq 1024 --batch 1
# after
git checkout d4e5f6
cmake --build build -j12
NSYS_OUTPUT=after nsight profile -o after --trace=cuda,cublas -- ./bench --seq 1024 --batch 1
```

priya: flame summary (topline):
```
before: attention kernels: 62% total runtime, ~18 launches across steps
after: attention kernels: 68% total runtime, ~62 launches (smaller kernels, more overhead)
```

ana.s: also saw SM_efficiency drop ~12% on the after trace and increased PCIe memcopy time by ~0.4ms per step (due to more frequent small workspace exchanges).

sam-runtime: so root cause = heuristic shift that increased kernel fragmentation. KV cache behavior not the trigger.

josh: plan: revert tile-merge change, add a microbench cost-model, and add perf regression gate (nsys diff) to CI for seq=512/1024 shapes.

sam-runtime: I'll open a revert PR and include the trace comparisons + NVTX screenshots. Also adding heuristics unit test that simulates our batch/seq distributions.

perf-bot: perf alert: master +17.8% p95 latency for seq=1024 benchmark. Filed INF-241 with attached traces.

priya: quick TODOs: 1) revert PR (sam) 2) add cost-model ticket (ana) 3) CI perf job for target shapes (josh) 4) add nsight baseline artifacts policy (liam).

ana.s: thanks everyone. once revert lands we'll re-run nightly and confirm p95/p99 back to baseline before closing INF-241.

liam: local revert confirms p95 back to baseline +/-1%. I'll paste the before/after numbers in INF-241.

priya: nice catch. adding a short blurb to #eng-runtime for visibility. :thumbsup:

ana.s: closing loop later today after CI runs. thanks!
